question: In Formula 1 seasons since 2001, considering only drivers who scored points in a season, which five constructors have had the most seasons where their drivers scored the fewest total points among all point-scoring drivers in that season?
sql:
-- Final answer: top 5 constructors with most seasons as fewest points
WITH constructor_season_points AS (
    SELECT 
        rac.year,
        c.constructor_id,
        c.name AS constructor_name,
        SUM(r.points) AS total_points
    FROM results r
    JOIN constructors c ON r.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    JOIN races rac ON r.race_id = rac.race_id
    WHERE rac.year >= 2001 AND r.points > 0
    GROUP BY rac.year, c.constructor_id, c.name
),
ranked_constructors AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        constructor_id,
        constructor_name,
        total_points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY total_points ASC) AS rn
    FROM constructor_season_points
),
constructor_counts AS (
    SELECT constructor_name, COUNT(*) AS num_seasons
    FROM ranked_constructors
    WHERE rn = 1
    GROUP BY constructor_name
)
SELECT constructor_name, num_seasons
FROM constructor_counts
ORDER BY num_seasons DESC, constructor_name ASC
LIMIT 5
